title: Project Overview
description: Start with the changelog and readme to understand what Jalmus is (a music notation trainer), its version history, and supported languages.

title: Application Entry Point
description: Jalmus.java is the Main-Class entry point: it builds the main window, menus, preferences, MIDI setup and starts the note/rhythm/score reading games.

title: Core Data Model
description: The musical building blocks: Note, Score, Chord, Interval and Tonality used throughout the exercises.

title: Lesson Loading
description: Lessons.java parses the bundled lesson XML files (SAX) and exposes them to the exercise levels.

title: Exercise Levels
description: The Level interface and its implementations: NoteLevel, ScoreLevel and RhythmLevel drive each exercise type.

title: User Interface
description: Piano provides the on-screen keyboard and ChooseNotePanel lets users pick notes during exercises.

title: MIDI and Audio
description: MidiCommon handles MIDI devices/sequencing and FileTools handles reading/writing lessons, preferences and resources.

title: Configuration and Localization
description: build.xml, settings.properties and the language_*.properties files internationalize the app into 13 languages.

title: Lesson Content
description: Bundled lesson XML files (260 lessons in 13 languages) define the note, rhythm and score exercises, e.g. the English 'An octave on treble clef' lesson.
